description: ocsp.rs: OcspChecker checks SingleResponse.this_update and SingleResponse.next_update but never checks ResponseData.produced_at. RFC 6960 §4.2.2.1 states that producedAt indicates when the response was signed. An OCSP response with a producedAt far in the future passes validation if the SingleResponse timestamps are within range. Minimum fix: reject if produced_at > now_unix + skew, or document why intentionally skipped.
title: OcspChecker does not check ResponseData.produced_at
